summary: A dense, engine-building worker-placement game where you send caravans out along three tracks (land, water, sky) while drafting dice as workers with escalating restrictions. It's a tight, crunchy puzzle with a strong solo mode, but sessions run long and the rules overhead is significant for new players.
praised: Gorgeous, evocative art and production quality
Rich, interlocking scoring paths that reward planning
Satisfying puzzle of optimizing dice-worker placement and caravan upgrades
criticised: Steep rules overhead and long teach for new players
Can suffer from analysis paralysis due to many simultaneous scoring avenues
Some randomness from dice rolls feels at odds with the game's otherwise heavy strategy
Playtime can drag, especially at higher player counts

interaction.kind: area majority and race-style tile/track claiming with light blocking

scoring.why: Victory comes from balancing mapping progress (land/water/sky), guild influence, noble inspiration, and caravan upgrades rather than any single dominant strategy
